baseline_comparison.interpretation: Stability depends on label geometry and class imbalance. These controls provide context, not validity, accuracy, acceptable error or a clinical optimum.
baseline_comparison.metric: Fixed-label boundary changes on exactly the same 8640 directed grid edges

r1_histogram_preserving_random_permutati.expectation_formula: 1 - sum_k n_k*(n_k-1)/(N*(N-1)), distinct vertices; no replacement
r1_histogram_preserving_random_permutati.interval_interpretation: Fixed-seed engineering controls, not confidence intervals or independent scientific replications

baseline_comparison.randomization_limits: Grid edges share vertices and opposite directions duplicate each edge; 8640 comparisons are not independent Bernoulli trials. No binomial CI or p-value is assigned to flip rates.

uniform_seven_class_iid.interval_interpretation: Fixed-seed engineering controls, not confidence intervals or independent scientific replications

constructive_nonidentifiability.additional_identification_requirements: Independent measurements or interventions isolating task access/capacity, and independently justified structural assumptions
assumptions: Each correct answer requires both a capacity factor and a task-access factor, with multiplicative success probability
Five independent, identically distributed Bernoulli trials per task and independence across tasks
Neither latent factor is directly measured or experimentally isolated by the four counters
This hypothetical model class is admitted for the logical counterexample only; it is not a validated model of any participant or disease
constructive_nonidentifiability.claim_ceiling: Counts alone cannot identify the factors within this admitted toy model class; this does not prove which mechanisms exist in people or that no richer study can identify them
constructive_nonidentifiability.forward_map: p_j = capacity_j * task_access_j; Y_j ~ Binomial(5,p_j), tasks independent
constructive_nonidentifiability.latent_space: Two distinct 4-tuples of capacity and task-access probabilities, each in {0,1/5,...,1}
constructive_nonidentifiability.proof: For any q != (1,1,1,1), latent A=(capacity=q, access=1) and latent B=(capacity=1, access=q) differ but produce the same p=q. Therefore P_A(Y=y)=P_B(Y=y) for every y in {0,...,5}^4, not just the displayed witness. The observable-distribution map is noninjective.

engineering_status_scope: Generated deterministic methods artifact; actual engineering validation requires tests, exact replay and remote CI with commit/run URL reported separately

assumptions: Independent participants; normally distributed participant-level paired differences
External fixed task norms on comparable scales; higher Z means better performance
Fixed external expected contrasts b_order/b_recall calibrated under the identical eligibility rule remove ordinary task and eligibility-induced mismatch
The hypothetical dz values are assumptions, not estimates from R1/R2 or literature p-values
Within-person trials are not independent sample-size units; trial dependence is absorbed in SD(D)
No site/family clustering; clustered recruitment requires redesign and new power analysis
20% missing or excluded pairs and 40% holdout are planning assumptions, not guaranteed retention
No selection on order or delayed-recall outcomes; eligibility uses independent engagement/recognition checks
power_analysis.calculation: Noncentral paired-t power via stdlib Simpson quadrature; 4096 panels
power_analysis.effect_definition: dz=population mean within-person standardized-task difference / SD of that difference
limits: No clinical effect, prevalence, trial reliability, missingness mechanism or variance has been estimated
The powered primary contrasts do not establish individual selective dissociation or causal mechanism
Small accessible archival cohorts may support only exploratory feasibility with uncertainty, never a lowered evidentiary gate
Final source-specific design must freeze instruments, external norms, eligibility, feasible N and deviations before any outcome access
power_analysis.model: T=(Z+dz*sqrt(n))/sqrt(V/(n-1)); Z normal, V chi-square, independent

multiplicity.joint_power: If both endpoints meet at least 90% marginal power, union bound gives at least 80% both-reject power, without assuming endpoint independence

power_analysis.zero_null_caveat: Seeing >=1 event rejects an error-free p=0 model trivially; that is not clinical sensitivity, prevalence validation, or a meaningful planning alternative here

r1_reproduction.unit_test_correction: Historical R1+R2 total 36 means software unit tests, not 36 clinical hypotheses

review_scope: Methods response to the external document review; independent code checks are not independent human data or independent clinical replication

threshold_sensitivity.grid: All 15 integer threshold pairs 0 <= LOW < HIGH <= 5, same fixed 1296 vectors
threshold_sensitivity.interpretation: Candidate numbers AND membership depend on arbitrary demo thresholds; not merely their clinical interpretation. Synthetic-grid fractions are not population prevalences.
threshold_sensitivity.selection_rule: Exhaustive reporting; no post-hoc best threshold selected
